canDoYue: 你識講頭痛發燒、一日食幾次、飯後先食、嗜睡，同埋邊種藥需要藥單。
canDoEn: Say you have a headache and a fever, ask how many times a day and whether to take it after meals, and notice when a medicine makes you drowsy or needs a prescription.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I have a headache and a fever, and I need some medicine from this pharmacy.
dialogue.glossYue: 我頭痛又發燒，要喺呢間藥房買藥。
dialogue.say: I have a headache and a fever, and I need some medicine from this pharmacy.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: This pharmacy can help with that fever, and some strong medicine here needs a prescription.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢間藥房可以幫你退燒，有啲強藥需要藥單。
dialogue.say: This pharmacy can help with that fever, and some strong medicine here needs a prescription.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: How many times a day do I take it, and is that after meals, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 我一日食幾多次，係咪飯後先食？
dialogue.say: How many times a day do I take it, and is that after meals, please?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: Please take it three times a day, and this tablet can make you feel drowsy.
dialogue.glossYue: 請一日食三次，呢種藥會令人嗜睡。
dialogue.say: Please take it three times a day, and this tablet can make you feel drowsy.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Should I take each tablet only after meals, or may I take it earlier?
dialogue.glossYue: 係咪每粒藥都要飯後先食，定係可以早啲食？
dialogue.say: Should I take each tablet only after meals, or may I take it earlier?

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: Please take it after meals, and do not drive if you feel drowsy later.
dialogue.glossYue: 請飯後先食，如果覺得嗜睡就唔好揸車。
dialogue.say: Please take it after meals, and do not drive if you feel drowsy later.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The written prescription says three times a day, and I will follow that note here.
dialogue.glossYue: 藥單寫一日三次，我會跟住張紙。
dialogue.say: The written prescription says three times a day, and I will follow that note here.

dialogue.speaker: suki
dialogue.text: Please keep this prescription with you, and rest at home if the fever returns.
dialogue.glossYue: 請帶住呢張藥單，發燒返嚟就喺屋企休息。
dialogue.say: Please keep this prescription with you, and rest at home if the fever returns.
